2: 
3: ## Architecture
4: The cinejoy-webos application is a standalone LG webOS TV application engineered for webOS 8.5.0 on the LG 32LR686BPSA television (1920x1080 Full HD). It implements a hybrid architecture:
5: 1. **Frontend Presentation Layer (`/app`)**: Clean, modular vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript compatible with Chromium ~108+. Implements 10-foot TV ergonomics (1920x1080 canvas, 48px/5% TV-safe margin, high-contrast `#95FF50` focus indicators, zero mouse hover reliance), deterministic spatial D-pad remote navigation, and HTML5 + `hls.js` video player.

# UI Modernization Master Plan — CineJoy LG webOS

## Objectives
Modernize CineJoy LG webOS (`com.cinejoy.tv`) to Google TV / cinema-grade aesthetic based on `theboringtv-lgwebos` reference design while strictly preserving service engines, proxy cascade, Luna keepalive, spatial D-pad navigation, and media playback.

## Non-Negotiable Invariants
1. `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/`: ZERO file changes, 100% byte-for-byte identical.
2. Proxy cascade: `launchParams.proxyUrl` > URL query `?proxyUrl=` > `localStorage` > `http://127.0.0.1:8088`.
3. Luna keepalive: `window._cinejoyLunaBridge` subscription hook preserved.
4. Spatial D-pad: deterministic routing (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Enter/OK), webOS Back key (`461`, `Escape`), high-contrast 10-foot focus halos.
5. Media playback: `<video id="main-video-player">` + HLS streaming lifecycle, range requests, seek handlers (±15s), audio/subtitle selectors.
6. webOS 8.5 environment: 1920x1080 canvas, 5% TV-safe overscan margins, zero scrollbars.

## Milestones & Strategy
- **Phase 0: Survey & Technical Mapping (3 Explorers)**
  - Explorer 1: Reference UI Analysis (`.tmp_ref/theboringtv-lgwebos/` tokens, CSS rules, backdrop overlays, pill nav, card dimensions, focus animations).
  - Explorer 2: Existing CineJoy Frontend Architecture (`app/index.html`, `app/css/`, `app/js/` controllers, DOM contracts, IDs, data attributes, navigation graph).
  - Explorer 3: Verification Harness & TV Deployment Pipeline (`tests/`, `scripts/verify-prod-ipk.js`, `ares-package`, LG TV `192.168.1.15` deployment requirements).
- **UI-M1: Design Token & Base Shell Modernization**
  - Integrate dark cinema background (`#0e1014`), `#shade` crossfading backdrop overlays, typography hierarchy, card surfaces (`#26292f`, radius 14px), metadata chips, Google TV top pill nav bar.
- **UI-M2: Shell, Views & Shelf Modernization**
  - Immersive hero spotlight with backdrop art, horizontal card carousels with GPU transform, sleek search view with virtual keyboard, elegant detail dialog overlay with cast chips and action pills.
- **UI-M3: Modernized Media Player HUD Overlay**
  - Redesign `#player-view` / `#player-overlay`: sleek scrub bar with buffered range visualization, elapsed/remaining time, floating action pills, responsive buffering indicator & non-intrusive stream error alert.
- **UI-M4: Spatial D-Pad Navigation & Modal Focus Trap Hardening**
  - Verify all interactive components have explicit `:focus` and `.focused` styling with scale (1.08-1.10) and white/accent halo; modal focus traps restore focus cleanly.
- **UI-M5: Verification Harness, IPK Packaging & Physical TV Deployment**
  - Run full test suite (`npm test`, 773+ checks pass), verify IPK (`node scripts/verify-prod-ipk.js` 7/7 pass), package with `ares-package`, deploy to LG 32LR686BPSA (`192.168.1.15`), and validate on-device navigation, playback, and seeking.

# Scope: CineJoy LG webOS UI Modernization

## Architecture
The CineJoy LG webOS UI Modernization brings a Google TV / cinema-grade design system to the `com.cinejoy.tv` webOS 8.5 application running at 1920x1080 on the LG 32LR686BPSA television, based on the reference project `.tmp_ref/theboringtv-lgwebos/`.
The architecture strictly enforces 5 non-negotiable invariants:
1. **On-Device Streaming Service Engine**: Zero changes to `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/` (`index.js`, `resolver.js`, `hls-proxy.js`, `http-client.js`, `crush.wasm`, `services.json`, `package.json`). Loopback proxy at `http://127.0.0.1:8088` remains 100% byte-for-byte intact.
2. **Frontend Service Keepalive & Proxy Cascade**: Retain `app/js/config.js` 4-stage cascade (`launchParams.proxyUrl` > URL query `?proxyUrl=` > `localStorage` > `http://127.0.0.1:8088`) and `app/js/app.js` persistent Luna keepalive subscription hook (`window._cinejoyLunaBridge` -> `luna://com.cinejoy.tv.service/keepalive`).
3. **Spatial D-Pad & Remote Control Engine**: Retain spatial navigation graph with Arrow keys, Enter/OK, and Back key (keycode 461 / Escape). 10-foot visible high-contrast focus rings and scale transforms.
4. **Media Playback Engine**: Retain HTML5 `<video id="main-video-player">`, low-memory Hls.js lifecycle, range requests, playhead tracking, seek handlers (±15s), and audio/subtitle selectors.
5. **webOS 8.5 Environment Constraints**: Fixed 1920x1080 canvas, 5% TV-safe margins (96px horizontal, 54px vertical), zero desktop scrollbars, pure HTML5/CSS3/ES6 compatible with webOS Chromium WAM.

## Feature Inventory
| # | Feature | Description | Milestone | Source |
|---|---------|-------------|-----------|--------|
| UI-F1 | Reference Design Token & Scrim Integration | `#0e1014` dark cinema canvas, `#shade` dual-gradient crossfading overlay, `#bgBlur` low-cost backdrop scrim, typography hierarchy (`#e8eaed`, `#bdc1c6`, `#9aa0a6`), card surface `#26292f` | UI-M1 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1 |
| UI-F2 | Google TV Top Pill Navigation Bar | Floating top pill bar (`.pill`, `.tab`) with smooth opacity/translate auto-hide on vertical scroll, retaining nav group & route contracts | UI-M1 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1, R2 |
| UI-F3 | Immersive Hero Spotlight & Dynamic Backdrop | Full-bleed hero banner with crossfading backdrop art blending into shelf scrims, metadata chips, action pills | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R2 |
| UI-F4 | Cinema Card Surfaces & Horizontal Shelf Strips | Card surfaces with 14px border radii, `#26292f` background, GPU-accelerated horizontal carousel translations (`will-change: transform; contain: layout style;`) | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1, R2 |
| UI-F5 | Modernized On-Screen Search & Virtual Keyboard | 5-row virtual keyboard with 72x64px rounded keys, 14px radius, Google TV search bar layout, live results grid | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R2 |
| UI-F6 | Elegant Full-Bleed Detail Overlay & Cast Chips | Full-bleed detail overlay with backdrop art, synopsis, cast chips, and pill action buttons (Play, Trailer, Back) | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R2 |
| UI-F7 | Modernized Media Player HUD Overlay | Redesigned `#player-view` / `#player-overlay`: sleek scrub bar, buffered range visualization, elapsed/remaining time, floating action pills, buffer indicator, error banner | UI-M3 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R3 |
| UI-F8 | Spatial Focus Indicators & 10-Foot Halo Elevation | High-contrast spatial focus states (`scale(1.08)` to `scale(1.10)` with `box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #fff` and neon lime halo glow), smooth cubic-bezier transitions | UI-M4 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1, R4 |
| UI-F9 | Modal Focus Traps & D-Pad Route Hardening | Explicit `:focus` and `.focused` styling on all interactive elements, modal focus traps with clean focus restoration to trigger element, Back key 461 handling | UI-M4 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R4 |
| UI-F10 | Automated Test Suite Pass (773/773 checks) | 100% pass of functional test suites across 24 test files (`npm test`) | UI-M5 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R5 |
| UI-F11 | Production IPK Packaging Integrity | Automated IPK verification via `node scripts/verify-prod-ipk.js` (7/7 checks passed) | UI-M5 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R5 |
| UI-F12 | Physical LG TV Deployment & On-Device Validation | `ares-package` build, installation, and on-device validation on LG 32LR686BPSA television (`192.168.1.15:9922`) | UI-M5 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R5 |

## Milestones
| # | Name | Scope | Dependencies | Status |
|---|------|-------|-------------|--------|
| UI-M1 | Reference Design Token & Base Shell Modernization | Tokens in `app/css/tokens.css`, `app/css/layout.css`, `app/index.html` (header pill bar, `#shade`, `#bgBlur`, cinema background `#0e1014`, typography hierarchy) | Survey | PLANNED |
| UI-M2 | Views, Hero Spotlight & Shelves Modernization | Modernize Home view, Hero banner, horizontal shelves, Movies/Series hubs, Search keyboard, Details overlay, 14px card radii, zero DOM sinks | UI-M1 | PLANNED |
| UI-M3 | Modernized Media Player HUD Overlay | Modernize `#view-player`, `#player-overlay`: progress scrub bar, buffered track, floating action pills, buffering spinner, error banner | UI-M1, UI-M2 | PLANNED |
| UI-M4 | Spatial D-Pad Navigation & Modal Focus Trap Hardening | High-contrast 10-foot focus halos (5px white + lime glow, scale 1.08-1.10), modal focus traps, back key handling | UI-M1, UI-M2, UI-M3 | PLANNED |
| UI-M5 | Verification Suite, IPK Packaging & TV Deployment | 100% test pass (`npm test`, 773+ checks), `verify-prod-ipk.js` (7/7 checks), `ares-package`, deploy to LG TV `192.168.1.15`, on-device playback validation | UI-M1, UI-M2, UI-M3, UI-M4 | PLANNED |

## Code Layout
- `app/css/tokens.css`: Color tokens, geometry tokens, typography tokens. Must maintain backward-compatible token names while setting cinema palette values.
- `app/css/layout.css`: 1080p canvas lock, TV-safe margins, `#shade` dual-gradient scrim, `#bgBlur` low-cost backdrop filter, top pill navigation layout, view visibility.
- `app/css/components.css`: Card surfaces (14px radius, `#26292f`), hero banner, shelves, keyboard keys (72x64), pill buttons, player HUD OSD overlay.
- `app/css/navigation.css`: Spatial focus states (`.focused`, `.tv-focused`, `:focus`), scale transforms, 5px white halo rings + neon glow, smooth cubic-bezier transitions.
- `app/index.html`: DOM shell containing 6 view containers (`#view-home`..`#view-player`), 66 DOM IDs, top pill nav bar, video element.
- `app/js/views/*`: View controllers rendering UI elements using pure DOM APIs (`document.createElement`, `classList`, `textContent`, `setAttribute` — ZERO `.innerHTML =`).
- `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/*`: IMMUTABLE on-device streaming service. ZERO changes permitted.

# Scope: CineJoy LG webOS UI Modernization

## Architecture
The CineJoy LG webOS UI Modernization brings a Google TV / cinema-grade design system to the `com.cinejoy.tv` webOS 8.5 application running at 1920x1080 on the LG 32LR686BPSA television, based on the reference project `.tmp_ref/theboringtv-lgwebos/`.
The architecture strictly enforces 5 non-negotiable invariants:
1. **On-Device Streaming Service Engine**: Zero changes to `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/` (`index.js`, `resolver.js`, `hls-proxy.js`, `http-client.js`, `crush.wasm`, `services.json`, `package.json`). Loopback proxy at `http://127.0.0.1:8088` remains 100% byte-for-byte intact.
2. **Frontend Service Keepalive & Proxy Cascade**: Retain `app/js/config.js` 4-stage cascade (`launchParams.proxyUrl` > URL query `?proxyUrl=` > `localStorage` > `http://127.0.0.1:8088`) and `app/js/app.js` persistent Luna keepalive subscription hook (`window._cinejoyLunaBridge` -> `luna://com.cinejoy.tv.service/keepalive`).
3. **Spatial D-Pad & Remote Control Engine**: Retain spatial navigation graph with Arrow keys, Enter/OK, and Back key (keycode 461 / Escape). 10-foot visible high-contrast focus rings and scale transforms.
4. **Media Playback Engine**: Retain HTML5 `<video id="main-video-player">`, low-memory Hls.js lifecycle, range requests, playhead tracking, seek handlers (±15s), and audio/subtitle selectors.
5. **webOS 8.5 Environment Constraints**: Fixed 1920x1080 canvas, 5% TV-safe margins (96px horizontal, 54px vertical), zero desktop scrollbars, pure HTML5/CSS3/ES6 compatible with webOS Chromium WAM.

## Feature Inventory
| # | Feature | Description | Milestone | Source |
|---|---------|-------------|-----------|--------|
| UI-F1 | Reference Design Token & Scrim Integration | `#0e1014` dark cinema canvas, `#shade` dual-gradient crossfading overlay, `#bgBlur` low-cost backdrop scrim, typography hierarchy (`#e8eaed`, `#bdc1c6`, `#9aa0a6`), card surface `#26292f` | UI-M1 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1 |
| UI-F2 | Google TV Top Pill Navigation Bar | Floating top pill bar (`.pill`, `.tab`) with smooth opacity/translate auto-hide on vertical scroll, retaining nav group & route contracts | UI-M1 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1, R2 |
| UI-F3 | Immersive Hero Spotlight & Dynamic Backdrop | Full-bleed hero banner with crossfading backdrop art blending into shelf scrims, metadata chips, action pills | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R2 |
| UI-F4 | Cinema Card Surfaces & Horizontal Shelf Strips | Card surfaces with 14px border radii, `#26292f` background, GPU-accelerated horizontal carousel translations (`will-change: transform; contain: layout style;`) | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1, R2 |
| UI-F5 | Modernized On-Screen Search & Virtual Keyboard | 5-row virtual keyboard with 72x64px rounded keys, 14px radius, Google TV search bar layout, live results grid | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R2 |
| UI-F6 | Elegant Full-Bleed Detail Overlay & Cast Chips | Full-bleed detail overlay with backdrop art, synopsis, cast chips, and pill action buttons (Play, Trailer, Back) | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R2 |
| UI-F7 | Modernized Media Player HUD Overlay | Redesigned `#player-view` / `#player-overlay`: sleek scrub bar, buffered range visualization, elapsed/remaining time, floating action pills, buffer indicator, error banner | UI-M3 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R3 |
| UI-F8 | Spatial Focus Indicators & 10-Foot Halo Elevation | High-contrast spatial focus states (`scale(1.08)` to `scale(1.10)` with `box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #fff` and neon lime halo glow), smooth cubic-bezier transitions | UI-M4 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1, R4 |
| UI-F9 | Modal Focus Traps & D-Pad Route Hardening | Explicit `:focus` and `.focused` styling on all interactive elements, modal focus traps with clean focus restoration to trigger element, Back key 461 handling | UI-M4 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R4 |
| UI-F10 | Automated Test Suite Pass (773/773 checks) | 100% pass of functional test suites across 24 test files (`npm test`) | UI-M5 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R5 |
| UI-F11 | Production IPK Packaging Integrity | Automated IPK verification via `node scripts/verify-prod-ipk.js` (7/7 checks passed) | UI-M5 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R5 |
| UI-F12 | Physical LG TV Deployment & On-Device Validation | `ares-package` build, installation, and on-device validation on LG 32LR686BPSA television (`192.168.1.15:9922`) | UI-M5 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R5 |

## Milestones
| # | Name | Scope | Dependencies | Status |
|---|------|-------|-------------|--------|
| UI-M1 | Reference Design Token & Base Shell Modernization | Tokens in `app/css/tokens.css`, `app/css/layout.css`, `app/index.html` (header pill bar, `#shade`, `#bgBlur`, cinema background `#0e1014`, typography hierarchy) | Survey | DONE |
| UI-M2 | Views, Hero Spotlight & Shelves Modernization | Modernize Home view, Hero banner, horizontal shelves, Movies/Series hubs, Search keyboard, Details overlay, 14px card radii, zero DOM sinks | UI-M1 | PLANNED |
| UI-M3 | Modernized Media Player HUD Overlay | Modernize `#view-player`, `#player-overlay`: progress scrub bar, buffered track, floating action pills, buffering spinner, error banner | UI-M1, UI-M2 | PLANNED |
| UI-M4 | Spatial D-Pad Navigation & Modal Focus Trap Hardening | High-contrast 10-foot focus halos (5px white + lime glow, scale 1.08-1.10), modal focus traps, back key handling | UI-M1, UI-M2, UI-M3 | PLANNED |
| UI-M5 | Verification Suite, IPK Packaging & TV Deployment | 100% test pass (`npm test`, 773+ checks), `verify-prod-ipk.js` (7/7 checks), `ares-package`, deploy to LG TV `192.168.1.15`, on-device playback validation | UI-M1, UI-M2, UI-M3, UI-M4 | PLANNED |

## Code Layout
- `app/css/tokens.css`: Color tokens, geometry tokens, typography tokens. Contains Google TV cinema tokens while maintaining backward-compatible baseline tokens.
- `app/css/layout.css`: 1080p canvas lock, TV-safe margins, `#shade` dual-gradient scrim, `#bgBlur` low-cost backdrop filter, top pill navigation layout, view visibility.
- `app/css/components.css`: Card surfaces (14px radius, `#26292f`), hero banner, shelves, keyboard keys (72x64), pill buttons, player HUD OSD overlay.
- `app/css/navigation.css`: Spatial focus states (`.focused`, `.tv-focused`, `:focus`), scale transforms, 5px white halo rings + neon glow, smooth cubic-bezier transitions.
- `app/index.html`: DOM shell containing 6 view containers (`#view-home`..`#view-player`), 78 DOM IDs (100% original 66 preserved), top pill nav bar, video element.
- `app/js/views/*`: View controllers rendering UI elements using pure DOM APIs (`document.createElement`, `classList`, `textContent`, `setAttribute` — ZERO `.innerHTML =`).
- `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/*`: IMMUTABLE on-device streaming service. ZERO changes permitted.

12: ## 1. Executive Summary
13: 
14: Milestone UI-M2 modernizes the user interface of CineJoy TV (`com.cinejoy.tv`) to deliver a Google TV cinema-grade television experience. As Explorer 2, our investigation covers:
15: 1. **Search Bar Architecture**: Adapting the 60px generic search bar into Google TV's signature 84px high `.sq` pill search bar (`#303134` dark surface, 42px border-radius, 34px typography, 40px search icon, `#8ab4f8` animated blinking caret).
16: 2. **On-Screen Virtual Keyboard Layout & Sizing**: Modernizing the 5-row virtual keyboard to exact Google TV specifications: 72px x 64px character keys, 14px border-radius, `#303134` background, `#e8eaed` text, 28px font, and 132px action keys (Space, Backspace, Clear) with 14px radius.
17: 3. **High-Contrast Focus System**: Upgrading key focus styling to high-contrast white `#FFFFFF` background, dark `#202124` text, and `scale(1.08)` transform, visible from 10 feet away.
18: 4. **Zero DOM Sinks & XSS Immunity**: Eliminating all instances of `.innerHTML =` and `.outerHTML =` in `app/js/views/search.js` by migrating `renderResults` and `renderError` to pure W3C DOM APIs (`document.createElement`, `classList`, `textContent`, `removeChild`), preventing script injection and DOM corruption.
19: 5. **Preservation of Non-Negotiable Invariants**: Strictly preserving all DOM IDs (`#search-input`, `#search-results-grid`, `#search-clear-btn`, `#search-query-text`, `#search-query-placeholder`, `#search-results-count`), maintaining all 39 keyboard keys (exceeding the >=38 key test requirement), keeping the spatial D-pad navigation matrix, and respecting 5% TV-safe margins ([96px, 1824px]).

47: The television screen operates at 1920x1080 resolution with a mandatory 5% overscan boundary:
48: - Horizontal safe margin: $96\text{px}$ on both left and right.

3: ## Mission
4: Modernize and redesign the user interface of the CineJoy LG webOS application (`com.cinejoy.tv`) using the Google TV / cinema-grade design language, layout patterns, and component styling from `https://github.com/theboringhumane/theboringtv-lgwebos` (available locally at `.tmp_ref/theboringtv-lgwebos/`), while strictly preserving all underlying service engines, media playback pipelines, spatial D-pad navigation, and on-device loopback proxy functionality.

12: 1. **On-Device Streaming Service Engine**:
13:    - Zero changes to files in `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/` (`index.js`, `resolver.js`, `hls-proxy.js`, `http-client.js`, `crush.wasm`, `services.json`, `package.json`).
14:    - Loopback proxy on `http://127.0.0.1:8088` must remain intact.
15: 2. **Frontend Service Keepalive & Proxy Cascade**:
16:    - Preserve `app/js/config.js` proxy resolution hierarchy (`launchParams.proxyUrl` > URL query `?proxyUrl=` > `localStorage` > `http://127.0.0.1:8088`).
17:    - Retain the persistent Luna keepalive subscription hook in `app/js/app.js` (`bridge.call('luna://com.cinejoy.tv.service/keepalive', JSON.stringify({ subscribe: true }))` on `window._cinejoyLunaBridge`).
18: 3. **Spatial D-Pad & Remote Control Engine**:
19:    - All interactive elements must maintain clear, deterministic D-pad focus routing (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Enter/OK).
20:    - Retain webOS Back key handling (keycode `461`, `Escape`, and `history.back`).
21:    - Focus states must use high-contrast halos and scale transforms visible from 10 feet away without relying on mouse hover.
22: 4. **Media Playback Engine**:
23:    - Retain HTML5 `<video id="main-video-player">` and HLS streaming lifecycle (range requests, playhead tracking, seek handlers ±15s, buffer health, audio/subtitle selectors).
24: 5. **webOS 8.5 Environment Constraints**:
25:    - Viewport strictly fixed at `1920x1080` with 5% TV-safe overscan margins (no desktop scrollbars, no horizontal overflow).
26:    - Pure HTML5, CSS3, and ES2019/ES6 JavaScript compatible with webOS Chromium WAM.
27: 
28: ## Core Requirements
29: - **R1. Reference Design Token & Pattern Integration**: Dark cinema background (`#0e1014`), `#shade` overlays, typography hierarchy (`#e8eaed`, `#bdc1c6`, `#9aa0a6`), metadata badges, card surfaces (`#26292f`, `border-radius: 14px`), horizontal shelf strips, top pill nav, high-contrast focus scale (1.08-1.10) with white halo.
30: - **R2. Shell, Views & Shelf Modernization**: Modernize `app/index.html` and `app/css/` across Home, Catalog, Search, and Detail dialogs. Preserve all DOM IDs (`#main-video-player`, `#catalog-view`, etc.), data attributes (`data-nav-group`, `data-id`), and controller contracts.
31: - **R3. Modernized Media Player HUD Overlay**: Redesign `#player-view` / `#player-overlay`, progress bar, buffered range, floating action pill buttons, buffer and error alerts.
32: - **R4. Spatial Focus Navigation & Focus Trap Integrity**: `:focus` and `.focused` styling, modal focus traps with clean focus restoration.
33: - **R5. Verification Harness, IPK Packaging & TV Deployment**: 100% test pass (`npm test`, 773+ checks), `node scripts/verify-prod-ipk.js` (7/7 checks), `ares-package`, deploy to physical LG TV `192.168.1.15`, on-device navigation, playback, and seeking validation.

35: ## Orchestrator Protocol
36: 1. Follow the orchestrator protocol strictly: decompose requirements into structured milestones, create `BRIEFING.md`, `plan.md`, `progress.md`, and manage subagent swarms (explorers, workers, reviewers, challengers, auditors).

1: # Scope: CineJoy LG webOS UI Modernization
2: 
3: ## Architecture
4: The CineJoy LG webOS UI Modernization brings a Google TV / cinema-grade design system to the `com.cinejoy.tv` webOS 8.5 application running at 1920x1080 on the LG 32LR686BPSA television, based on the reference project `.tmp_ref/theboringtv-lgwebos/`.
5: The architecture strictly enforces 5 non-negotiable invariants:
6: 1. **On-Device Streaming Service Engine**: Zero changes to `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/` (`index.js`, `resolver.js`, `hls-proxy.js`, `http-client.js`, `crush.wasm`, `services.json`, `package.json`). Loopback proxy at `http://127.0.0.1:8088` remains 100% byte-for-byte intact.
7: 2. **Frontend Service Keepalive & Proxy Cascade**: Retain `app/js/config.js` 4-stage cascade (`launchParams.proxyUrl` > URL query `?proxyUrl=` > `localStorage` > `http://127.0.0.1:8088`) and `app/js/app.js` persistent Luna keepalive subscription hook (`window._cinejoyLunaBridge` -> `luna://com.cinejoy.tv.service/keepalive`).
8: 3. **Spatial D-Pad & Remote Control Engine**: Retain spatial navigation graph with Arrow keys, Enter/OK, and Back key (keycode 461 / Escape). 10-foot visible high-contrast focus rings and scale transforms.
9: 4. **Media Playback Engine**: Retain HTML5 `<video id="main-video-player">`, low-memory Hls.js lifecycle, range requests, playhead tracking, seek handlers (±15s), and audio/subtitle selectors.
10: 5. **webOS 8.5 Environment Constraints**: Fixed 1920x1080 canvas, 5% TV-safe margins (96px horizontal, 54px vertical), zero desktop scrollbars, pure HTML5/CSS3/ES6 compatible with webOS Chromium WAM.
11: 
12: ## Feature Inventory
13: | # | Feature | Description | Milestone | Source |
14: |---|---------|-------------|-----------|--------|
15: | UI-F1 | Reference Design Token & Scrim Integration | `#0e1014` dark cinema canvas, `#shade` dual-gradient crossfading overlay, `#bgBlur` low-cost backdrop scrim, typography hierarchy (`#e8eaed`, `#bdc1c6`, `#9aa0a6`), card surface `#26292f` | UI-M1 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1 |
16: | UI-F2 | Google TV Top Pill Navigation Bar | Floating top pill bar (`.pill`, `.tab`) with smooth opacity/translate auto-hide on vertical scroll, retaining nav group & route contracts | UI-M1 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1, R2 |
17: | UI-F3 | Immersive Hero Spotlight & Dynamic Backdrop | Full-bleed hero banner with crossfading backdrop art blending into shelf scrims, metadata chips, action pills | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R2 |
18: | UI-F4 | Cinema Card Surfaces & Horizontal Shelf Strips | Card surfaces with 14px border radii, `#26292f` background, GPU-accelerated horizontal carousel translations (`will-change: transform; contain: layout style;`) | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1, R2 |
19: | UI-F5 | Modernized On-Screen Search & Virtual Keyboard | 5-row virtual keyboard with 72x64px rounded keys, 14px radius, Google TV search bar layout, live results grid | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R2 |
20: | UI-F6 | Elegant Full-Bleed Detail Overlay & Cast Chips | Full-bleed detail overlay with backdrop art, synopsis, cast chips, and pill action buttons (Play, Trailer, Back) | UI-M2 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R2 |
21: | UI-F7 | Modernized Media Player HUD Overlay | Redesigned `#player-view` / `#player-overlay`: sleek scrub bar, buffered range visualization, elapsed/remaining time, floating action pills, buffer indicator, error banner | UI-M3 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R3 |
22: | UI-F8 | Spatial Focus Indicators & 10-Foot Halo Elevation | High-contrast spatial focus states (`scale(1.08)` to `scale(1.10)` with `box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #fff` and neon lime halo glow), smooth cubic-bezier transitions | UI-M4 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R1, R4 |
23: | UI-F9 | Modal Focus Traps & D-Pad Route Hardening | Explicit `:focus` and `.focused` styling on all interactive elements, modal focus traps with clean focus restoration to trigger element, Back key 461 handling | UI-M4 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R4 |
24: | UI-F10 | Automated Test Suite Pass (773/773 checks) | 100% pass of functional test suites across 24 test files (`npm test`) | UI-M5 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R5 |
25: | UI-F11 | Production IPK Packaging Integrity | Automated IPK verification via `node scripts/verify-prod-ipk.js` (7/7 checks passed) | UI-M5 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R5 |
26: | UI-F12 | Physical LG TV Deployment & On-Device Validation | `ares-package` build, installation, and on-device validation on LG 32LR686BPSA television (`192.168.1.15:9922`) | UI-M5 | ORIGINAL_REQUEST § R5 |

39: - `app/css/layout.css`: 1080p canvas lock, TV-safe margins, `#shade` dual-gradient scrim, `#bgBlur` low-cost backdrop filter, top pill navigation layout, view visibility.

44: - `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/*`: IMMUTABLE on-device streaming service. ZERO changes permitted.

# Dispatch: Milestone UI-M4 Explorer 1 (10-Foot Spatial Focus Styling)

## Mission
Investigate `app/css/navigation.css`, `app/css/components.css`, `app/css/layout.css`, and `app/css/tokens.css` to audit and standardize 10-foot spatial focus states across ALL interactive components in CineJoy webOS.

## Inputs to Read
1. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/ORIGINAL_REQUEST.md` (read verbatim intent)
2. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/orchestrator_ui/SCOPE.md`
3. `app/css/navigation.css`
4. `app/css/tokens.css`
5. `app/css/components.css`
6. `app/css/layout.css`

## Objectives
1. Audit all focus selectors: `.focused`, `.tv-focused`, and `:focus`.
2. Standardize Google TV / cinema 10-foot spatial focus hierarchy:
   - Elevation: `transform: scale(1.08)` to `scale(1.10)` (`!important` where needed for TV compositor).
   - High-contrast white halo ring: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #FFFFFF, 0 0 28px rgba(149, 255, 80, 0.65)` (or component-appropriate lime glow).
   - Inverted contrast dynamic on buttons/pills: surface flips to `#FFFFFF`, text/icons flip to `#202124` (15.9:1 contrast, WCAG AAA).
   - Card surfaces (220x330 poster, 320x180 episode, hero spotlight): high-contrast border + halo glow without clipping sibling elements.
   - Header navigation pills (`.pill`, `.tab`): capsule elevation and active indicator contrast.
   - Virtual keyboard keys: 72x64px keys elevation and white halo.
3. Verify CSS transition curves: `transition: transform 0.2s var(--cinema-ease-decel), box-shadow 0.2s var(--cinema-ease-decel)`.
4. Ensure hardware acceleration: `transform: translateZ(0)` on focusable containers, avoiding jitter or layout reflows.
5. Formulate concrete, surgical edits for `app/css/navigation.css` and `app/css/components.css`.

## Deliverables
- Detailed investigation report in `report.md`.
- Standard self-contained handoff in `handoff.md`.
- Notify orchestrator using `send_message`.

Investigate remote Back key handling (keycode 461 on webOS remote, 27 Escape on keyboard/simulator) and view history management across `app/js/navigation.js`, `app/js/app.js`, and all view controllers.

## Objectives
1. Audit remote Back key (keycode 461) capture:
   - Window/document event listeners (`keydown`, `webOSRelaunch`).
   - Priority stack for Back key routing:
     Tier 1: Close active modal dialog (Subtitles, Server, Error dialog in Player; any open dialog in views).
     Tier 2: Dismiss full-bleed Details overlay (`#view-details`) back to invoking shelf card.
     Tier 3: Exit Player HUD / video playback (`#view-player`) back to Details or invoking view.
     Tier 4: From Search / Movies / Series back to Home view.
     Tier 5: At top-level Home view root, handle webOS application exit gracefully (`window.close()` or webOS platform exit).
2. Verify zero circular navigation loops or orphaned states under rapid Back key hammering.
3. Verify remote D-pad keycode mapping:
   - Up (38), Down (40), Left (37), Right (39), OK/Enter (13).
   - Back (461 / 27).
   - Play (415), Pause (19), Play/Pause (10252), Stop (413), Fast Forward (417), Rewind (412).
4. Verify non-negotiable invariants:
   - Zero changes to `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/`.
   - Preserve `app/js/config.js` cascade and Luna keepalive in `app.js`.
   - ZERO DOM sinks.
5. Formulate concrete recommendations and test specifications for Back key routing.

## Deliverables

2: 
3: **Date**: 2026-11-05T03:34:00Z  
4: **Agent**: Explorer 1 (`explorer_ui_m4_1`)  
5: **Target Architecture**: LG webOS 8.5.0 (Full HD 1920x1080, Chromium ~108 WAM, aarch64 SoC)  
6: **Assigned Working Directory**: `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/explorer_ui_m4_1/`
7: 
8: ---
9: 
10: ## 1. Executive Summary
11: 
12: Milestone UI-M4 focuses on standardizing spatial D-pad remote control focus states across all interactive components in CineJoy webOS (`com.cinejoy.tv`). The target visual design language is the Google TV / cinema-grade aesthetic derived from `.tmp_ref/theboringtv-lgwebos/`, merged seamlessly with CineJoy's high-contrast brand identity (electric neon lime `#95FF50` and deep obsidian canvas `#04120B`).
13: 
14: Our investigation of `app/css/navigation.css`, `app/css/components.css`, `app/css/layout.css`, and `app/css/tokens.css`, in conjunction with all 24 automated test suites (773/773 passing checks), revealed a critical architectural finding:
15: - **Stylesheet Cascade Conflict**: In `app/index.html` (lines 9-12), `css/navigation.css` is loaded **after** `css/components.css`.
16: - `navigation.css` currently contains legacy Milestone 3 focus rules (`border: 3px solid #95FF50 !important`, `scale(1.12)`, `scale(1.15)`, and translucent green backgrounds `rgba(149, 255, 80, 0.25)`).
17: - Because `navigation.css` rules use `!important`, they **completely override and clobber** modernized focus states defined in `components.css` (such as the 5px pure white halo ring, inverted contrast `#FFFFFF` surface with `#202124` text, and scale 1.08-1.10).
18: - Furthermore, generic `[data-nav="true"].focused` in `navigation.css` injects a 3px border and 1.08 scale onto non-box components like `#osd-scrubber` (`.osd-progress-track`), causing visual artifacts.
19: 
20: This report documents the empirical audit of all focus selectors across all interactive elements, computes exact WCAG AAA luminance contrast ratios, formulates a zero-reflow GPU compositor acceleration strategy, and delivers concrete, surgical CSS proposals for `navigation.css` and supporting stylesheets.
21: 
22: ---
23: 
24: ## 2. Stylesheet Cascade & Architecture Audit
25: 
26: ### 2.1 Stylesheet Load Order (`app/index.html` lines 9-12)
27: ```html
28: <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/tokens.css">
29: <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/layout.css">
30: <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/components.css">
31: <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/navigation.css">
32: ```
33: Under W3C CSS Cascading and Inheritance Level 4:
34: When two rules have equal specificity and both declare `!important`, the declaration appearing later in the document tree wins.
35: Consequently:
36: $$\text{Priority: } \text{navigation.css} > \text{components.css} > \text{layout.css} > \text{tokens.css}$$
37: 
38: ### 2.2 Empirical Conflict Matrix

53: ## 3. Standardized 10-Foot Focus Specifications
54: 
55: To establish a unified, harmonious 10-foot TV experience, all focusable components must follow standardized spatial focus hierarchies.
56: 
57: ### 3.1 Design Principles
58: 1. **Dual-Layer Halo Ring**:
59:    - Layer 1 (Inner/Contact): `0 0 0 5px #FFFFFF` (5px crisp, pure white core ring)
60:    - Layer 2 (Outer/Atmospheric): `0 0 28px rgba(149, 255, 80, 0.65)` (electric neon lime glow for brand recognition)
61:    - Layer 3 (Depth/OLED Shadow): `0 16px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85)` (deep elevation shadow for contrast against bright backdrop imagery)
62: 2. **Inverted Contrast Dynamic (Pills, Buttons, Keyboard Keys)**:
63:    - Rest State: Translucent dark gray/glass surface (`rgba(60, 64, 67, 0.55)` or `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`), light text (`#e8eaed` or `#bdc1c6`).
64:    - Focused State: Surface flips to pure white `#FFFFFF !important`, text flips to dark charcoal `#202124 !important`, SVG icons invert to `stroke: #202124 !important; fill: none !important;`.
65:    - Contrast Ratio: **16.03:1** (far exceeding WCAG AAA 7.0:1 requirement).
66: 3. **Card Media Surfaces**:
67:    - Card container scales by `scale(1.08) translateZ(0) !important;` with `z-index: 50 !important;`.
68:    - Media container (`.poster-media`, `.episode-media`) carries the 5px white halo ring and 28px neon glow.
69:    - Text metadata (`.poster-title`, `.episode-title`) elevates to `#FFFFFF !important` or `#95FF50 !important`.
70:    - Grid padding (96px horizontal, 54px vertical) and gaps (24px horizontal, 28px vertical) ensure zero clipping or horizontal scrollbar emergence.
71: 4. **Hardware Acceleration & GPU Compositing**:
72:    - Every focusable element must include `transform: translateZ(0)` during resting and focused states.
73:    - When elevating via `scale(1.08)`, always declare `transform: scale(1.08) translateZ(0) !important;` so the browser's graphics compositor (Chromium WAM on webOS) retains the dedicated GPU backing store and avoids texture re-allocation.

# Dispatch: Milestone UI-M4 Implementation Worker (Spatial Navigation & Modal Focus Hardening)

## Mission
Implement the standardized 10-foot spatial focus states and harden the `SpatialNav` engine, modal focus traps, and remote Back key routing based on synthesized findings from Explorers 1, 2, and 3.

## Inputs to Read
1. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/ORIGINAL_REQUEST.md` (read verbatim user intent)
2. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/orchestrator_ui/SCOPE.md`
3. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/explorer_ui_m4_1/report.md` (Focus styling & cascade fix)
4. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/explorer_ui_m4_2/report.md` (SpatialNav engine & modal trap hardening)
5. `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/explorer_ui_m4_3/report.md` (Remote Back key routing & keycode 10252)
6. Target files:
   - `app/css/navigation.css`
   - `app/css/tokens.css`
   - `app/js/navigation.js`
   - `app/js/views/search.js`
   - `app/js/player.js`

## Exclusive Write Ownership
You have exclusive write ownership of:
- `app/css/navigation.css`
- `app/css/tokens.css`
- `app/js/navigation.js`
- `app/js/views/search.js`
- `app/js/player.js`
Do NOT modify:
- `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/` (STRICT ZERO CHANGES)
- `app/js/config.js`
- `app/js/app.js`

## Mandatory Integrity Warning
DO NOT CHEAT. All implementations must be genuine. DO NOT hardcode test results, create dummy/facade implementations, or circumvent the intended task. A teamwork_preview_auditor will independently verify your work. Integrity violations WILL be detected and your work WILL be rejected.

## Detailed Work Instructions

### 1. `app/css/navigation.css` Modernization & Cascade Conflict Resolution (Explorer 1):
- Update `app/css/navigation.css` to align with Google TV 10-foot TV ergonomics and eliminate the cascade clobbering of `components.css`:
  - Standardize focus halo: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #FFFFFF, 0 0 28px rgba(149, 255, 80, 0.65) !important;` (retaining `#95FF50` tokens for backward-compatible test assertions).
  - Standardize elevation: `transform: scale(1.08) translateZ(0) !important;` (with `z-index: 50 !important;`).
  - Inverted contrast dynamic on buttons, pills, tabs, and keys: `#FFFFFF !important` background, `#202124 !important` text/stroke (16:1 contrast ratio, WCAG AAA).
  - Play button focus: `#B4FF78 !important` background, `#04120B !important` icon/text, 5px white halo ring.
  - Media card surfaces: 220x330 poster and 320x180 episode media containers receive 5px white halo + 28px lime glow + deep OLED shadow (`0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.85)`).
  - Virtual keyboard keys: 72x64px keys receive `scale(1.08)` and 4px white halo with inverted `#FFFFFF` / `#202124` contrast.
  - Inhibit generic scaling on `.osd-progress-track`: set `transform: none !important; border: none !important; height: 12px !important;` so the 1728px track does not distort; expand `.osd-scrub-thumb` to 24px with 5px white halo.
  - Ensure zero layout reflows (GPU acceleration `translateZ(0)` on all focusable elements).

### 2. `app/js/navigation.js` Modal Focus Trap & Self-Healing Hardening (Explorer 2 & 3):
- **Trap Stack**: Upgrade `state.activeTrap` to support an internal `_trapStack = []` so sequential or nested modal traps do not prematurely untrap parent containers. `trap(container)` pushes to stack and sets `state.activeTrap`; `untrap()` pops from stack and restores previous container (or null).
- **Trap-Aware Self-Healing**: In `move(direction)`, if `state.activeTrap` is active and the current focus is lost or detached, recover focus immediately to the first/best candidate inside `state.activeTrap` (rather than delegating to whole-view recovery which rejects trapped scopes).
- **LG Magic Remote Keycode 10252 (`VK_PLAY_PAUSE`)**: Add keycode `10252` to `KEYS.PLAY_PAUSE` array/constants alongside `179` so physical webOS remote Play/Pause buttons trigger playback toggling.
- **Back Key Early Break**: In `handleBackNavigation()`, if a listener returns `true`, break early to avoid redundant handler execution.

### 3. `app/js/views/search.js` Keyboard Re-Entry Trap Hardening (Explorer 2):
- When navigating with `ArrowUp` from `#search-results-grid` back into `.tv-keyboard-container`, re-engage the keyboard trap so upward navigation from Row 1 does not leak into `.app-header`.

### 4. `app/js/player.js` Modal Dismissal Fallback & Keycode 10252 (Explorer 2 & 3):
- In `PlayerOSDController.closeActiveModal()`, implement a multi-tiered fallback cascade when restoring focus: if `subtitlesBtn` or `serverBtn` is not navigable, fallback to `d.playBtn`, then `SpatialNav.restoreFocus('player')`.
- Ensure keycode `10252` is recognized in media key handlers.

### 5. Automated Verification:
Run all verification commands:
- `grep -rn "\.innerHTML\s*=" app/js/` (must return 0 matches)
- `node tests/adversarial-m4-stress.js`
- `node tests/adversarial-challenger-m3.js`
- `node tests/adversarial-m2-journeys.js`
- `node tests/test-details-player-adversarial.js`
- `node scripts/verify-prod-ipk.js`
- `npm test` (all 24 suites, 773+ checks passed)

Deliver your implementation findings in `report.md` and standard self-contained handoff in `handoff.md` in your working directory.
Notify orchestrator using `send_message`.

# Task Assignment: Milestone UI-M5 Production Verification, Packaging & TV Deployment

## 2026-11-05T04:35:00Z

### Mission
Execute Milestone UI-M5 of the CineJoy LG webOS UI Modernization project:
Run the complete automated test suite (24/24 suites, 773+ checks), package the modernized application into production IPK, verify IPK package integrity (7/7 checks), deploy to the physical LG 32LR686BPSA television (`192.168.1.15:9922`), launch the application, and validate live on-device operation (catalog navigation, 1080p stream playback, seeking ±15s, memory stability, and zero crashes).

### Constraints & Invariants
- STRICT SERVICE IMMUTABILITY: `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/` must remain byte-for-byte identical.
- ZERO DOM SINKS: Confirm zero `.innerHTML =` or `.outerHTML =` in `app/js/`.
- MANDATORY INTEGRITY WARNING: DO NOT CHEAT. All implementations must be genuine. DO NOT hardcode test results, create dummy/facade implementations, or circumvent the intended task. A forensic auditor will independently verify your work.

### Steps to Execute
1. Run full test suite:
   `npm test`
   Ensure 24/24 test suites pass and all 773+ assertions succeed.
2. Build production IPK:
   `ares-package app services/com.cinejoy.tv.service -o dist`
   Verify `dist/com.cinejoy.tv_1.0.0_all.ipk` is generated.
3. Run package verification:
   `node scripts/verify-prod-ipk.js`

   `ares-install --device lg-tv dist/com.cinejoy.tv_1.0.0_all.ipk`
   Verify successful package transfer and installation on LG 32LR686BPSA (`192.168.1.15:9922`).
5. Launch on physical LG TV:
   `ares-launch --device lg-tv com.cinejoy.tv`
   Verify application launches and connects.
6. Verify live on-device operation:
   Run `node tests/test-tv-prod-verification.js` (and check running processes via `ares-launch -r --device lg-tv com.cinejoy.tv`) to validate:
   - App is running on device
   - Catalog loads and renders with modernized Google TV cinema UI
   - 10-foot spatial focus halos respond to remote D-pad input
   - 1080p stream playback initiates through local service loopback proxy (`http://127.0.0.1:8088`)
   - Seeking (±15s) functions accurately with modernized HUD scrub bar
   - Memory footprint remains stable (<75MB webOS threshold)
7. Document all execution commands, raw outputs, and test logs in `report.md` and deliver `handoff.md`.
8. Send notification via `send_message` when complete.
